name: legal-contract-agent
description: Legal Contract Agent - AI-driven legal document and clause analysis

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,AI,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" "npm run backend:dev" "npm run ai:start" "npm run frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,AI,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" "npm run backend" "npm run ai:start" "npm run frontend"
scripts.ai:start: cd ai-service && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.test: npm run ai:test && npm run test:pipeline && npm run test:e2e
